description: Decrypt ciphertext using a KMS key. Only AES256 or RSA2048 key types supported. Ciphertext must include KMS prefix (ncpkms:version:ciphertext).

ciphertext.description: Ciphertext data including KMS prefix (string or array of strings)

context.description: Base64-encoded context used during encryption (required if convergent encryption was used)

keyTag.description: Key tag - unique identifier derived from key name

name: ncloud_kms_decrypt
